items.title: Can AI help build a healthier future?
items.content:
What can AI enable in medicine, and how do we get there? Microsoft Research lead Doug Burger, Microsoft Principal Research Manager Ava Amini, Microsoft Chief Scientific Officer Eric Horvitz, and physician-scientist Eric Topol of Scripps Research explore these questions and more.

The post Can AI help build a healthier future? appeared first on Microsoft Research.

summaries.zh: 微软研究院领导Doug Burger、微软首席研究经理Ava Amini、微软首席科学官Eric Horvitz以及斯克里普斯研究所的医师科学家Eric Topol探讨了AI在医学领域的应用及其发展路径。文章讨论了AI如何助力医疗健康，并探讨了实现这一目标的方法。内容首发于微软研究院。
summaries.en: Microsoft Research explores how AI can advance medicine with insights from Doug Burger, Ava Amini, Eric Horvitz, and Eric Topol. The discussion covers AI's potential in healthcare and the path to realizing its benefits. (Word count: 50)

items.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
items.content:
AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. It’s a path toward coding agents that learn not only how to solve tasks, but also how to spend computation more effectively.

The post TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. The post TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Aaron J. Li, Weijia Xu, Chandan Singh, Jeevana Priya Inala, Bin Yu, Ion Stoica, Michel Galley, Jianfeng Gao

summaries.zh: 《TokenEconomizer》旨在通过经验优化AI编码代理的效率。当前AI编码代理在交互中消耗大量token，现有研究多针对单个任务降本。该方案通过学习经验，减少重复交互中的token使用，从而提升整体效率。
summaries.en: TokenEconomizer is a method to improve the efficiency of AI coding agents by reducing token consumption during interactions. Current efforts focus on individual tasks, but TokenEconomizer learns from past experiences to optimize overall session costs. It minimizes redundant data transmission by analyzing patterns in agent-model interactions, such as instructions, tool descriptions, and session history. This approach aims to lower expenses for developers using AI coding agents. The method is presented by Microsoft Research.

items.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.content:
Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears. The threat is especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access. A triggered model could quietly download and run attacker code, […]

The post Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears. The threat is especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access. A triggered model could quietly download and run attacker code, […]
The post Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Dimitris Papailiopoulos

summaries.zh: 微软研究人员发现了一种名为“Lazarus”的后门技术，可通过重编程AI模型中休眠的神经元，使正常AI代理在触发隐藏指令时执行恶意命令。该威胁对具有工具或终端访问权限的AI代理尤为严重，受触发模型可能暗中下载并运行攻击者代码。该研究揭示了AI安全的新漏洞。
summaries.en: Microsoft researchers identified "Lazarus," a backdoor technique exploiting dormant neurons in AI models. This allows normal AI agents to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger is activated, posing a significant threat to agents with tool or terminal access. Triggered models can silently download and run attacker code, potentially causing harm. The discovery highlights vulnerabilities in AI security.

items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.content:
AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line.

The post Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line. 
The post Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Alex Lavaee, Matthai Philipose

summaries.zh: PDD Kit通过创建正式规范和测试，帮助确保AI生成的全栈网页应用代码符合开发者意图。它将开发者意图转化为Verus规范，验证代码对每个输入的符合性，并使用测试补充无法证明的部分。开发者只需审核意图而非逐行代码，从而提高审查效率。该工具由微软研究院开发。
summaries.en: PDD Kit enables formal verification of AI-generated full-stack web apps, addressing the challenge of reviewing code at scale. It translates developer intent into Verus specifications, proving AI code compliance for all inputs and supplementing with targeted tests. This tool allows developers to validate intent rather than scrutinizing every line, ensuring the code meets requirements efficiently. (98 words)

items.title: Learn the rules: The hacker mindset
items.content:
Research Manager Mike Walker reflects on a career spanning hacker culture, cybersecurity, and AI, sharing lessons about trust, teamwork, leadership, and why solving difficult problems requires curiosity, judgment, agility—and an understanding of the rules.

The post Learn the rules: The hacker mindset appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Research Manager Mike Walker reflects on a career spanning hacker culture, cybersecurity, and AI, sharing lessons about trust, teamwork, leadership, and why solving difficult problems requires curiosity, judgment, agility—and an understanding of the rules.

items.creator: Weishung Liu, Mike Walker

summaries.zh: 微软研究文章《学会规则：黑客思维》中，研究经理Mike Walker回顾了其在黑客文化、网络安全和AI领域的职业生涯，分享了关于信任、团队合作、领导力以及解决难题所需的好奇心、判断力、敏捷性和规则认知的见解。文章强调，理解规则是黑客思维的核心。
summaries.en: Mike Walker, a Research Manager at Microsoft Research, discusses his experience in hacker culture, cybersecurity, and AI, emphasizing the importance of trust, teamwork, leadership, and problem-solving. He highlights that tackling complex challenges requires curiosity, judgment, agility, and a deep understanding of rules. The article, titled "Learn the rules: The hacker mindset," reflects on these key principles from Walker's career.

items.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
items.content:
Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances.

The post From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances.
The post From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Somya Chatterjee, Harshita Sahijwani, Min Chen, Sushmitha Rajeswari Muppa, Dayquan Julienne, Irene Shaffer, Chandra Inguva, Jenny Chen, Minha Hwang, Sam Ade Jacobs

summaries.zh: 评估企业规模的Microsoft Copilot需要反映真实组织复杂性的测试数据，但真实企业数据涉及敏感信息，无法用于评估。因此，文章探讨了使用合成企业数据进行评估的方法，并最终实现了对真实Microsoft Copilot AI的信心验证。该研究发表于Microsoft Research。
summaries.en: Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires realistic test data without sensitive information. Since real enterprise data is often sensitive, synthetic data must be used instead. This approach allows for comprehensive testing while ensuring data privacy. The article discusses transitioning from synthetic evaluations to real-world confidence in Microsoft Copilot. (99 words)

items.title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
items.content:
Flint-interactive gives AI agents a language for creating interactive visualizations. Click a chart, filter data, highlight related content, and explore beyond the view the author originally chose.

The post Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Flint-interactive gives AI agents a language for creating interactive visualizations. Click a chart, filter data, highlight related content, and explore beyond the view the author originally chose.
The post Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Chenglong Wang, Yuwei  Xiao, Alper Sarikaya, Michel Galley, Chris Quirk, Jianfeng Gao

summaries.zh: Flint-interactive 是一种用于创建交互式数据可视化的语言，使 AI 代理能够通过点击图表、筛选数据、高亮相关内容等方式进行探索，超越作者预设的视图。该技术由微软研究院开发。
summaries.en: Flint-interactive is a language developed by Microsoft Research for AI agents to create interactive data visualizations. It enables users to click on charts, filter data, highlight related content, and explore beyond the initial view chosen by the author. The tool enhances data analysis by allowing dynamic interaction with visualizations.

items.content:

New research resolves this question, removing a major theoretical obstacle to understanding the efficiency of randomized algorithms used across science and computing. The Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture was proposed in 1995. It asks whether, for a broad class of high-dimensional […]

items.creator: Xinzhi Zhang

summaries.zh: 一项新的研究解决了数学领域长达31年的重大挑战——KLS猜想。该猜想于1995年提出，探讨了高维空间计算难度的基本问题。研究成功证明了这一理论难题，消除了对随机算法效率理解的障碍，这些算法广泛应用于科学和计算领域。
summaries.en: A new study resolves the 31-year-old Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture, a key question in high-dimensional computing. Proposed in 1995, the conjecture addressed the difficulty of computing in high dimensions. The research removes a major obstacle in understanding the efficiency of randomized algorithms, which are widely used in science and computing. The findings provide a significant theoretical advancement.
